theorem complete_result (boxRequest : Result Unit) (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize)
    (z : Array NP 2#usize) : copied boxRequest v alpha z = original boxRequest v alpha z

theorem value_law (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    ∃ w : Weight,
      PV_B2_C_WeightsNative.host_weights.Weights.new (fromVariant v)
        (amap fromQ alpha) (amap fromPoint z) = ok (.Ok w) ∧
      copied (ok ()) v alpha z = ok (.Ok (toWeight w))

theorem failure (e : Error) (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    copied (fail e) v alpha z = fail e

theorem divergence (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    copied div v alpha z = div

theorem rust_error (boxRequest : Result Unit) (e : PV_B2_C_Carrier.verifier.Error) :
    finish boxRequest (.Err e) = ok (.Err (toError e))

theorem source (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (request : Result Outcome)
    (boxRequest : Result Unit) (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base))
    (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op252 (types base) (selected base request boxRequest ops) v alpha z =
      PV_B2_F_ConstructorEffect.original boxRequest v alpha z

theorem value_law (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (request : Result Outcome)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base))
    (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    ∃ w : Weight,
      PV_B2_C_WeightsNative.host_weights.Weights.new (fromVariant v)
        (amap fromQ alpha) (amap fromPoint z) = ok (.Ok w) ∧
      @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op252 (types base) (selected base request (ok ()) ops) v alpha z =
        ok (.Ok (toWeight w))

theorem nonvacuity (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (request : Result Outcome)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base))
    (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    ∃ w, @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op252 (types base) (selected base request (ok ()) ops) v alpha z =
      ok (.Ok w)

theorem failure (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (request : Result Outcome) (e : Error)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base))
    (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op252 (types base) (selected base request (fail e) ops) v alpha z = fail e

theorem divergence (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (request : Result Outcome)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base))
    (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op252 (types base) (selected base request div ops) v alpha z = div

theorem dictionaries (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (request : Result Outcome)
    (boxRequest : Result Unit) (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) :
    selected base request boxRequest ops = originalDictionary base request boxRequest ops

theorem observations {O : Sort _} (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (observe : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base) → O) (request : Result Outcome)
    (boxRequest : Result Unit) (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) :
    observe (selected base request boxRequest ops) = observe (originalDictionary base request boxRequest ops)

theorem amap_roundtrip {α β : Type} {n : Usize} (f : α → β) (g : β → α)
    (h : ∀ x,g (f x)=x) (a : Array α n) : amap g (amap f a)=a
theorem q_roundtrip (q : K) : from251Q (to251Q q)=q
theorem variant_roundtrip (v : Variant) : from251Variant (to251Variant v)=v

theorem q_array_roundtrip {n : Usize} (a : Array K n) :
    amap from251Q (amap to251Q a)=a

theorem q_matrix_roundtrip {n m : Usize} (a : Array (Array K n) m) :
    amap (amap from251Q) (amap (amap to251Q) a)=a

theorem q_tensor_roundtrip {n m k : Usize} (a : Array (Array (Array K n) m) k) :
    amap (amap (amap from251Q)) (amap (amap (amap to251Q)) a)=a
theorem weight_roundtrip (w : Weight) : fromWeight (toWeight w)=w
theorem alpha_roundtrip (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) : amap toQ (amap fromQ alpha)=alpha
theorem points_roundtrip (z : Array NP 2#usize) : amap toPoint (amap fromPoint z)=z

theorem four_rows (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (request : Result Outcome)
    (boxRequest : Result Unit) (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base))
    (b : PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.Bytes) (w : W) (kappa : E)
    (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op249 (types base) (selected base request boxRequest ops) b =
      PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.mapResult PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.toNative
        (PV_B2_E_GammaOriginal.originalGamma b) ∧
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op250 (types base) (selected base request boxRequest ops) b =
      PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.mapResult PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.toNative
        (PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.original b) ∧
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base) (selected base request boxRequest ops) w kappa =
      PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.mapResult PV_B2_F_MaterializeNative.mapRust
        (PV_B2_F_MaterializeRequest.original request w (PV_B2_F_MaterializeNative.fromNative kappa)) ∧
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op252 (types base) (selected base request boxRequest ops) v alpha z =
      PV_B2_F_ConstructorEffect.original boxRequest v alpha z

native_link_evidence_class: Reviewed frozen-source fixed-row/caller-Box structural association, universal Lean complete Result equality for every Box request context, exact native carrier/dictionary composition, compiled layout assertion and finite native allocation/drop/value witnesses; not fresh extraction of original Box/Drop closure
scope: Selected candidate source/callback row. Actual native execution/RunJoin installation, OS-failure witness independence and L1/L2/L3 remain P obligations.

theorem heap_source (heap : HeapRequest) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    heapCallback heap w kappa = heapOriginal heap w kappa

theorem box_source (box : BoxRequest) (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    boxCallback box v alpha z = boxOriginal box v alpha z

theorem selected_heap (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (heap : HeapRequest) (box : BoxRequest)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base) (selected base heap box ops) w kappa =
      heapOriginal heap w kappa

theorem selected_box (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (heap : HeapRequest) (box : BoxRequest)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op252 (types base) (selected base heap box ops) v alpha z =
      boxOriginal box v alpha z

theorem dictionaries (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (heap : HeapRequest) (box : BoxRequest)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) :
    selected base heap box ops = originalDictionary base heap box ops

theorem observations {O : Sort _} (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (observe : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base) → O) (heap : HeapRequest) (box : BoxRequest)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) :
    observe (selected base heap box ops) = observe (originalDictionary base heap box ops)

theorem heap_nonvacuity (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    ∃ out, @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base)
      (selected base (fun _ _ => ok .supplied) (fun _ _ _ => ok ()) ops) w kappa = ok (.Ok out)

theorem box_nonvacuity (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    ∃ out, @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op252 (types base)
      (selected base (fun _ _ => ok .supplied) (fun _ _ _ => ok ()) ops) v alpha z = ok (.Ok out)
